brief: Trial NCT02406508 (Delcath Systems, phase 2). What happened to it, how many people enrolled, and does it owe results?

findings.claim: Trial NCT02406508 has an overall status of WITHDRAWN.
The stated why_stopped reason for trial NCT02406508 is "No enrollment in the study", categorized under enrollment.
findings.notes: Snapshot and live record both confirm this reason.

findings.claim: Trial NCT02406508 started in October 2014 and had a primary completion date and completion date of December 2017.
Enrollment for trial NCT02406508 was 0 people.
Trial NCT02406508 does not owe results and has no results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.
findings.notes: Results are not due because the trial never enrolled participants (stopped_never_enrolled).

tool_calls.name: get_trial_live
tool_calls.result: NCT02406508: WITHDRAWN, why_stopped='No enrollment in the study'

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.results_posted, d.days_late, d.stopped FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT02406508'
